messages:
Sam: quick async check-in — yesterday: finished Node + Python quickstarts update, bumped sample app deps, fixed mac wheel packaging by pinning buildext.
Sam: blocker: sample-app e2e is failing in GH actions because REDWOOD_API_URL isn't set in one matrix job -> flakes on auth step. Also need another pair of eyes on PR #432 (sample-apps).
Sam: today: open a small CI fallback PR, respond to docs reviews, and cut a patch release for the quickstart if CI is green. @Priya can you look at the ESM packaging bit later? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/432 :eyes:

Priya: on it — I'll review after breakfast. For ESM packaging, local quick test: run with Node 18+ and `--conditions` change fixed one of our imports. Suggest adding note in README.

Jon: tiny docs nit — the CLI step in quickstart still says `redwood init` but we renamed it to `redwood quickstart`. I can send a one-line fix. Also saw a missing triple-fenced block in the python auth snippet.

Maya: I can open the CI fallback PR if you want, Sam. I already pushed a branch `ci/fallback-RED-432` with an env fallback to avoid flakes.

Sam: please open it, Maya — I'll add the test vector and tag you. Thanks!

deploy-bot: CI started for branch ci/fallback-RED-432 (workflow: sampleapp-e2e) :rocket:

Priya: added a comment on the ESM import to the PR and a short README patch recommending Node >= 18. Also left a TODO for testing on m1 macs.

Jon: pushed a docs commit fixing `redwood init` -> `redwood quickstart` and added the fenced code for python auth:
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
```

Maya: CI is green on the branch now. If no objections I'll open the PR in 15m. :thumbsup:

Sam: awesome — if green I'll merge and then cut a patch release for quickstarts. Quick follow-ups: Jon please review the README change, Priya please sanity-check ESM notes, Maya I'll hand off release notes to you to publish.

Priya: will do a final pass after lunch.

Jon: reviewing now, should be quick.

Sam: thanks all — I'll post a short changelog when it's merged.
